truthQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_customers on customer_id = t_customers.customer_id } extend { join_one: t_regions on t_customers.state = t_regions.state } -> { group_by: region is t_regions.region; aggregate: revenue is sale_price.sum(); order_by: revenue desc; limit: 1 }
verifyQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_customers on customer_id = t_customers.customer_id } extend { join_one: t_regions on t_customers.state = t_regions.state } -> { where: t_regions.region = 'South'; aggregate: revenue is sale_price.sum() }
